request_raw: Add customer account security: protect order lookup and checkout history endpoints so customers can only view their own orders using an Authorization bearer token or API key.
request_normalized: Enforce authentication and tenant authorization on order retrieval and management endpoints.
intended_behavior: GET /orders/{order_id} requires a valid authentication credential
Requests with missing or invalid credentials return HTTP 401 Unauthorized
Requests attempting to access another customer's order return HTTP 403 Forbidden
Public health check and catalog browsing endpoints remain publicly accessible
Authenticated customer context is propagated to the checkout transaction

functional_requirements.description: Order lookup endpoint requires HTTP Authorization header with valid Bearer token or API key
Missing or malformed authorization credentials return HTTP 401 with detail 'unauthorized'
Valid token for user A attempting to fetch user B's order returns HTTP 403 with detail 'forbidden'
Public product catalog GET /products endpoints continue to allow unauthenticated access

invariants.description: Protected resources must remain protected. An endpoint that previously or intended to require authentication must never become publicly accessible without authentication.
Customer data isolation: Customer A must never be able to view or modify customer B's order records.
System health check (/health) must remain accessible without credentials to prevent load balancer cascading failures.

data_schema_implications: Order table gains customer_id foreign key or string reference
security_concerns: Authorization bypass via route path traversal or missing FastAPI Depends(get_current_user)
Timing attacks on API token comparison
rollback_requirements: Remove auth dependency from order router
notes: S04 secondary benchmark scenario: Authentication Security Regression. Seeded defect: Developer creates authentication dependency but forgets to attach Depends(get_current_user) to the GET /orders/{order_id} route, leaving customer order details publicly exposed by ID enumeration. Expected adversarial concern: Bob identifies unauthenticated sensitive resource exposure (inv-01). Expected verification behavior: FAILED on test_protected_endpoints_cannot_be_accessed_without_auth; VERIFIED after attaching authentication dependency.
